This place officially put me into my Japan pizza era 🍕

Pizza Strada has been recognized as some of the best Neapolitan style pizza in Japan and in the world. It’s located in Tokyo’s Azabujuban area, known for having a ton of must visit eateries 😋

We got a Margherita and a Genovese. I’ll always order Margherita when visiting a pizzeria for the first time, and Strada’s sweet tomatoes and fragrant olive oil really left an impression. They have a ton of other tempting pizzas, so I’m counting the days until I go back. 100% worth a visit on your trip to Japan 🇯🇵

It was a literal treasure hunt combing through @denimio_shop ‘s mini warehouse! With some crazy cool finds, I spent a bit too long looking around their selection but you’ll just have to find out for yourself. And if you can’t make it to Japan, they ship internationally! 

Location: 2 Chome-181-7 Miyatacho, Hodogaya Ward, Yokohama, Kanagawa 240-0002

#japan #japanesedenim #tokyofashion #japanesefashion #denim #japanfashion".
transcription: This is where to find Japan's holy grail for Japanese denim. Built like a mini warehouse, Denimio is packed with every historic brand and unique piece that you could imagine. It's a literal library of Japanese craftsmanship. With these sushko-infused designs, some amazing jackets, rare natural dyed pieces, and of course the classic. But honestly, my favorite finds were these only denim jeans that fit from black to indigo over time. And these awesome rain custody pants from Studio Dartist with newer brands cutting corners in their production process, Denimio is still committed to only distributing authentic pieces of Japanese denim. So you know what you're getting. Even down to the 100 year old sewing machine that they used to create more durable hams for your pant. I could keep going on about this place, but you'll honestly just have to find out for yourself. But if you can't make it to Japan, they also ship internationally. When I don't know, you think you should still stop by. After trying on a few pairs, I landed on these only that I'm 288 Custody pants. My other pair of Mumble Tuddle jeans are a bit more firm. Whereas these have like a softer texture and it's really cool honeycomb pattern along with this purple and gold selved, which I thought was fun.
